trash_description: Local: cancels the phantom +4000 'Language: Not English' on dual-audio anime movies. At grab time Radarr parses language from the release title (often Unknown, which matches Language: Not English); at import it reads the file (JA+EN) and the CF drops off, so the release is rejected as not an upgrade. Fires only when the title says dual-audio AND English is missing from the parsed languages, so it is inactive after import.
name: Anime Dual Audio Misparsed

specifications.name: Dual Audio (same regex as Anime Dual Audio)
